name: Celebrimbor House
description: The floor under every forge: a warm-neutral ground, one deep accent, and a five-step type scale that works when nothing else is known. Adapt it; never ship it unchanged without saying so.
origin: Written for this skill. No third-party data. MIT, same licence as the skill.
useWhen: The user named a brand we have no palette for and gave no colours.
No sector matched and no direction could be composed.
The product is internal tooling where the system must disappear, not perform.

rules: Body text is 16px or larger; nothing is set below 13px.
One accent. It marks the single most important thing on a screen and nothing else.
Surfaces are separated by a hairline or by space, never by both.
Radius is one value on the whole product unless a surface argues otherwise.
Colour never carries meaning alone; every coloured state also changes weight, shape or text.
